<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Anti-paper leak legislation:</strong> The Lok Sabha has begun a significant debate on the anti-paper leak bill, which proposes penalties of up to 10 years in prison and fines reaching Rs 10 crore, following a week-long parliamentary deadlock.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I13</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Supreme Court intervention:</strong> The Supreme Court has issued a notice regarding the anti-defection law, citing &quot;enormous issues&quot; with its enforcement by parliamentary members.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxQaGFCUnNFWGpQRElsOVgwbmk2NzVPWXpfakdHYnhhUjRwUFQ2TFhudE53bGhQQWhCOG50YkRiQ2JPNWhjdnlWbmxQNExQVVMzQnk1NkVNNWNaYnJXLVpiWjA4VWxmNzlGXzlTSmVsUkM1ZlBYRzZFX25adGlQel83ZDJkZ3F6ZlBCMF8yZFdrSEJ4MjcyeTdHMHgwcDlySUpTRFh4b0J0Z2RmMTVoZG9OMQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I24</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I25</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I26</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Parliamentary protests:</strong> Opposition parties, including the Congress and Samajwadi Party, continue to stage protests in Parliament, demanding accountability for NEET-related issues and the crackdown on student protesters in Bihar.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I35</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I39</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>NDA coalition developments:</strong> Prime Minister Modi attended the NDA’s &#x27;Mangal Milan&#x27; meeting, which saw the first participation of NCPI MPs, even as the MNF—an NDA ally—broke ranks to oppose the upcoming FCRA Bill.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikAFBVV95cUxNT0hMcWFfZ09FTDRGbGlVeXVxY1Z0UHd3TUV0MFVHNk81S3N0UDA1LTQ5dWpETFQ1QlNWOHNNWXNpWVVWZmp4X2thNTh3ZFdZWWF2dXgzUGFURmtiMjJNNThMU0l1TE55QVh4eVJpODRWbGhvQThLMWtjLXNfa2NUckd2MFo2YnRCSkdlR2Y3S2c?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W19</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W20</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Digital regulation:</strong> A parliamentary panel has summoned major social media platforms, including Meta, X, Google, and Snapchat, to discuss digital regulation following recent controversies.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a></span></li>
</ul>
